children: Mineros subsidiaries entered into two committed credit facilities totaling $250M: a $150M international tranche and a $100M Nicaraguan tranche. Both have five-year terms, interest at Term SOFR plus 4.975% per annum, and principal repayments beginning in month 18.
Adds access to financing, but the company may draw funds in whole or in part and is not required to use them immediately.
Proceeds may support Porvenir’s next development phase and advancement of La Pepa; draw timing and amounts are not specified.
Reimburses Hemco fixed-asset investments made with its own funds, converting prior investment into available liquidity.
Sets borrowing cost at a floating rate, exposing drawn balances to changes in Term SOFR.
Provides an 18-month principal grace period; repayment is scheduled in eight installments.

This is a financing and liquidity update alongside Mineros’ stated growth plans for Porvenir and La Pepa, not a report of project results. Drawdowns, project progress, and compliance with facility covenants will determine whether the committed financing becomes a larger catalyst.
from Mineros S.A. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
